confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors come from search snippets on Numbeo-style Oslo data, Tromso aggregator guides and Norwegian price references. Sources disagree by roughly 20-30 percent, and cocktail and wine figures are mostly Oslo-based with an assumed small Tromso discount. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search performed, so they are low confidence. FX: the 0.6720 USD per AUD value (2026-11-18) was taken from search results that quoted the RBA 4.00 pm feed; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Oslo and other Norwegian urban restaurant and bar levels, adjusted for Tromso's high Arctic-city cost base. Accommodation is judged from general knowledge of northern Norwegian summer demand, not from listings.
